text: Salvage! Everything the sea gave back. Mostly rust, some treasure.
{npc}. If it sank, I've probably got a bit of it.
Careful on the raft, it moves. Everything moves out here.
Keep your voice down. There are marines about, and your face is on the posters.
I'll serve you, but quickly. Bounty hunters drink in here.
Listen to that thunder. Nobody sane is at sea tonight.
Storm's right on top of us. Stay in the dry a while.
Every timber in the harbour's groaning. Ugly night.
Wretched rain. Gets into everything.
Rain again. Good for the cisterns, bad for the soul.
You're dripping on my floor, by the way.
Late to be wandering about.
Night's when the cursed come walking. Keep a lantern lit.
Can't sleep either, eh?
Up with the gulls, I see.
Early start, {player}.
Mist'll burn off by mid-morning.

options.label: Tell me about the ship graveyard.

text: Chain, nails, hull plating, the odd strongbox. Once, a piano. Nobody's bought the piano.
Six wrecks on Crooked Reef, more under the sand. The drowned walk on them at low tide.
One of them's the Meridian Fleet's. You'd know her if you saw her: three masts, all broken.
Iron nuggets, chain, nautilus shells. Hearts of the sea, if you've got one. Don't tell me where you got it.
